title: No file of the tools, skills or docs names the autopilot agent feature, and the Windows Autopilot product is untouched
goal: A sweep after the removals, scoped to the AGENT feature only: git grep over _tools, .claude, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and kb/_self finds no autopilot.py, autopilot_rehearse, kb-autopilot, KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER, bl_bounds or '--by autopilot' (outside kb/_self/_decisions.csv, the backlog item files and _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt, which keep history); the map.csv rows, README.md, plugin.md and maintaining.md skill tables name no removed file or skill; the selfdoc map and cohesion checks pass. The Windows/Intune Autopilot product is NEVER touched: kb/public/autopilot/*, the product lists of README.md, plugin.json and the kb-lookup skill, .gitattributes csdl entries and tests_allowlist.txt stay as they are. No new runbook section: one agent works one item at a time.

run: import subprocess,sys; pat='autopilot[.]py|autopilot_rehearse|kb-autopilot|KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER|bl_bounds|--by autopilot'; o=subprocess.run(['git','grep','-n','-E',pat,'--','_tools','.claude','AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md','kb/_self',':!kb/_self/_decisions.csv',':!kb/_self/backlog/',':!_tools/test_ids_dropped.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip(); sys.exit(1 if o else 0)

notes: Order: runs last of the sprint (after the three removals land); no depends_on because a docs-only task may not depend on the code whose docs it sweeps.
